int powerMod(int b, int e, int mod) {
	long x=1;
	while (e>0) {
		if (e%2==1)
			x=(x*b) % mod;
		b= (b*b) % mod;
		e=e/2;
	}
	return (int) x%mod; 
}

		this->idx = idx;
		this->x = x;
		this->d = d;
	}

	bool operator < (const Composite& other) const {
		if (v < other.v)
			return true;
		if (v > other.v)
			return false;
		return idx < other.idx;
	}

};
